entities.summary: Jia Yi was a Chinese essayist, poet and politician of the Western Han dynasty, best known as one of the earliest known writers of fu rhapsody and for his essay "Disquisition (on) Finding Fault with Qin", which criticises the Qin dynasty and describes Jia's opinions on the reasons for its collapse.
